## Deliverable

`test/xaas/generation/substitution_policy_depth_test.exs` — 8 tests (task asked ≥5),
all tagged `:w984cw3`, placed under the lane-contract dir `test/xaas/generation/`
(module's home domain dir was not lane-writable). No mocks; collaborators are the real
canonical TTL on disk and pure functions over it. Each test carries an inline mutation
rationale:

1. policy/0 projects fields/standings/authority/flags from the real TTL — kills
   projection-drop and constant-inversion mutants (one assertion per parse!/1 guard).
2. ttl_sha256 binds to recomputed disk digest — kills hardcoded-digest mutants.
3. Removing each of the 4 requiredQualificationField lines raises required-field drift —
   kills list-vs-MapSet and lax-regex mutants, per-field.
4. admittedStanding/unknownStanding/authorityBoundary drift raise the matching typed
   errors — kills clause-reorder and wrong-constant mutants.
5. Flipping each mandatory boolean (true→false) raises — kills regex-that-matches-anywhere
   mutants that would read the flipped value as still true.
6. admit_receipt full refusal matrix: :ok, subject_missing, subject_not_exact,
   qualification_unknown, qualification_not_alive, receipt_missing — one per typed atom.
7. Exact-subject grammar boundaries: 39/41 hex, non-hex, space — fail-closed; nil missing.
8. Admission tracks the parsed policy, not hardcoded literals (asserts against
   `p.admitted_standing`/`p.unknown_standing` read at runtime) — kills
   hardcoded-standing mutants.
